name: Turn an accepted finding into an eval case, then compare two seeded runs
description: From PR #482's Agent runs tab, open the seeded Security Reviewer run, accept its SSRF finding and click 'Turn into eval case' (confirmation names the kind, 'In eval set' replaces the button). Then the agent's Evals tab lists the new case with a 'must find' badge, the per-agent dashboard (/eval/<agent>) shows the seeded runs and the regression banner, and comparing two runs shows both versions, the deltas and the prompt diff. The 'run -> edit prompt -> run' segment of SPEC-01 AC-42 is covered by server/test/eval-suite-runs.it.test.ts with MockLLMProvider (no model call here). Read-only seeded data except the one case this flow creates. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (e2e-web.yml); run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
